tlg_checks.note: skipped — Latin work; TLG E check applies to Greek works only. Independent verification instead: the famous 396-pivot sentence 'in cuius quaestionis solutione laboratum est quidem pro libero arbitrio uoluntatis humanae, sed uicit dei gratia' (Retract. 2.27.3, on Ad Simplicianum) matches the attested wording verbatim.

edition_statement: Pius Knöll (ed.), Sancti Aureli Augustini Opera, Sectio I Pars II: Retractationum libri II, CSEL 36, F. Tempsky / G. Freytag, Vienna-Leipzig 1902. TEI from OpenGreekAndLatin/csel-dev (University of Leipzig 2014, CC BY-SA 4.0), OCR by Jouve.
issues: Source is OCR of CSEL 36 (Knöll 1902); chapter numbering of Book 2 is continuous old-style (Ad Simplicianum = Retract. 2.27, not Mutzenbecher II.1; De Gratia et Libero Arbitrio under old ch. numbering near 2.66/92 equivalent). KG description cites Mutzenbecher CCSL 57 numbering — locus mapping differs.
2 sections empty in the digital edition and skipped: 1.3.6, 2.69.5 (encoding gaps, no text in TEI).

Residual OCR artifacts kept verbatim (zero-fix policy): 'quo- Diam' for quoniam (1.7.3), 'pro- Sciant' (1.14.11), 'uolun- .' truncated word (1.12.6), 'quod- ei' spurious hyphen (2.85.1), '0 utinam' digit zero for O (1.1.14), 'intrabitiš' diacritic artifact (1.18.6), 'Dc ordine' for De (1.3.11).

Editorial-only removals (documented): 8 leaked CSEL marginal line numbers (standalone 15/20), 2 stray OCR bullets ('»' 1.9.10, '•' 2.59.2), 7 verified line-break hyphenations rejoined (explicit list, e.g. disci-plinis, inter-rogatio).
48 sections under 50 chars are genuine short units (mostly the quaestio-title list of Retract. 1.25 = De diversis quaestionibus LXXXIII), kept verbatim.

Apparatus criticus, source footnotes, chapter/margin note markers and CAPVT headings stripped; no TEI tags or note text leaked (regex gate passed); all text Latin script + one genuine Greek word ἐγχερίδιον (2.89.1).
